title: Plugin packages' same-server reads stay cookie-only and break under a bearer-only session: the #37080 family outside app-shell and the console (16 files), plus two app-shell reads the #37185 ratchet does not see
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYmRepQK9DkZeU7F53D

Filing gate: ① a product defect with named locations (a closure card for one mechanism) · Source: fleet (the #37080 dev's out-of-scope findings in its round-0 report on PR #37185; the seat repo:objectstack#4 ruled that they be filed as one closure card; filed by zone a4-U)

## What happens

#37080 (PR #37185) moves the same-server `/api/` reads and writes in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/**` and `ui/apps/console/src/**` from a bare `fetch(…, { credentials: 'include' })` to `createAuthenticatedFetch` (`@object-ui/auth`). Under a bearer-only session (no session cookie, for example a cross-site embed or a cloud tenant whose cookie is not sent), a cookie-only call is answered as anonymous. Its feature then shows nothing, or a 401 that never reaches the session-ended check.

The same mechanism remains outside those two trees. It also remains in two app-shell reads that #37185's ratchet does not cover.

## The sites, enumerated at `origin/main` 93bd4595

Files that carry `credentials: 'include'`. The number is the count of matches. The marker `bearer by hand?` means the file names `Authorization` or an authenticated fetch somewhere, so some of its calls may already carry the bearer; the dev measures each call.

- `ui/packages/components/src/share/ShareDialog.tsx` (3)
- `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/hooks/useRecordCrudVerdicts.ts` (2)
- `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/hooks/useRowApprovalLocks.ts` (1)
- `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/useRecordEditable.ts` (2, bearer by hand?)
- `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/stageChangeStarts.tsx` (1)
- `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/queueClaim.ts` (1)
- `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/usePendingActions.ts` (2, bearer by hand?)
- `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/useHitlInChat.ts` (1, bearer by hand?)
- `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/useAiModels.ts` (1)
- `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/useAgents.ts` (1)
- `ui/packages/plugin-charts/src/ObjectChart.tsx` (2, bearer by hand?)
- `ui/packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DatasetWidget.tsx` (1)
- `ui/packages/plugin-report/src/ReportDateRange.tsx` (1)
- `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/preferenceOptions.ts` (1)
- `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/ShareableObjectRefField.tsx` (1)
- `ui/packages/permissions/src/MePermissionsProvider.tsx` (2, bearer by hand?)

Two app-shell reads #37185 does not convert:

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/widgets.tsx` `fetchFieldSelectorOptions` (~1201) calls `fetch('/api/v1/objects/:name/fields')` with no init. The default `same-origin` credentials make it cookie-only, and #37185's ratchet does not match a call with no init.
- `LocalizationFetchProvider` and `languageSeed` read `/api/v1/auth/me/localization` cookie-only. Under a bearer-only session the console likely falls back to the browser language instead of the user's locale. This is read, not measured. Constraint: #37185 lists `LocalizationFetchProvider` on its allow-list on purpose, because the boot read is shared in flight with `index.html`'s early request, keyed by its init. The bearer has to reach that early request too, or the share breaks.

## Expected

Every same-server read and write in these packages goes through `createAuthenticatedFetch` (one built per call, as in #37185), with `credentials: 'include'` kept. A cross-origin or author-written target uses `sameOriginOnly` or stays bare, with its reason recorded.

## Acceptance

- Each site above is converted or recorded with its reason. A call that already sets the bearer by hand is converted too, so a 401 reaches the session-ended check (the #37185 precedent).
- A pin that counts them: extend #37185's ratchet (`sameServerFetch.bearer.ratchet.test.ts`), or add a sibling, over the plugin trees. It refuses a bare cookie-only call, and a call with no init on a `/api/` path, outside a shrink-only list.
- One measured case per package family, pinned against a server that answers only the bearer, with a cookie-only control.
- The localization read: the bearer reaches both the early `index.html` request and the provider, and the in-flight share still holds. Pin that the share key still matches.
- One `patch` changeset per moved package.

Blocked-by: #37185

Grading: area:ux · Bug · moderate to impeded (features read as anonymous or empty under a bearer-only session) · reach named (bearer-only sessions, the mechanism #37080 measured in the shell) · evidence read, per site → p2; triage to confirm. Likely size L by file surface, so its own cloud session.

Business reason: a user on a bearer-only session sees their chatbot agents and models, record edit verdicts, approval locks, queue claims, share dialog, charts, dashboards and permissions read as anonymous. The shell itself (after #37185) works, so the failures look random.

Reader: the zone that claims it, after #37185 lands, starting from #37185's ratchet.

Dedupe: `createAuthenticatedFetch` (open and closed) → 30 hits; the open ones are #37080 (the shell half) and this mechanism's own PR. `cookie-only` and `bearer-only` → #37080 and #36981 (closed, the console Setup pages). `me/localization bearer` → no open card. No card covers these sites.
